title: Air Jordan
blurb: Michael Jordan's signature basketball shoe line, which turned sneakers into collectibles.

title: Brogue shoe
blurb: A sturdy leather shoe decorated with punched holes that once let bog water drain out.

title: Chelsea boot
blurb: A close-fitting ankle boot with elastic side panels, Victorian in origin and very 1960s in spirit.

title: Chuck Taylor All-Stars
blurb: A canvas basketball shoe from 1917 that left the court and never stopped being worn.

title: Clog
blurb: A shoe carved partly or wholly from wood, from Dutch klompen to Swedish träskor.

title: Dr. Martens
blurb: Air-cushioned work boots with yellow stitching, adopted by punks, postmen and everyone in between.

title: Espadrille
blurb: A canvas summer shoe with a sole of braided jute rope, from the Pyrenees.

title: Flip-flops
blurb: The simplest sandal there is: a flat sole and a Y-shaped strap between the toes.

title: Moccasin
blurb: A soft deerskin shoe of Indigenous North American origin, stitched from a single piece of hide.

title: Pointe shoe
blurb: The satin ballet shoe with a stiffened box that lets a dancer stand on the tips of the toes.

title: Stiletto heel
blurb: A tall, needle-thin heel named after a dagger, engineered around a steel core.

title: Wellington boot
blurb: A knee-high waterproof rubber boot, named for a duke and perfected for puddles.
